stem: What can be predicted about all sixth and seventh graders at lunch? Complete the statements to make inferences that are best supported by the information in the graph.
instruction: Move the correct answer to each box. Each answer may be used more than once. Not all answers will be used.
response_template:
More sixth graders would choose [blank_1] than would choose either one of the other two subjects.

More seventh graders would choose [blank_2] than would choose either one of the other two subjects.
visual_elements: Bar graph showing 'Favorite Nonacademic Subject' for Sixth graders and Seventh graders with subjects Art, Physical education, Music and their number of responses.
notes: Drag and Drop type question with fill-in blanks for two statements related to a bar graph comparing sixth and seventh graders' favorite nonacademic subjects.
